name: Hugging In Public
overview: Scripture reveals that God’s love and presence provide strength and peace, encouraging believers to embody His love visibly to the world. The Lord’s care as our shepherd and His promise to uphold us inspire confidence and hope, grounded in His steadfast love poured into our hearts by the Holy Spirit. Demonstrating love openly, as Jesus commands, serves as a testimony of discipleship, reflecting the divine love that gave His Son for our salvation.
